sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Clock Head is a game about catching glowing orbs with your clock arm while avoiding obstacles and managing your time. The clock arm moves in a continuous motion, and you must tap or click at the right moment to catch the orbs and earn points. The clock's size decreases with each missed orb, and if it disappears completely, the game is over. The orbs appear at random intervals, requiring you to stay focused and react quickly to the changing situation.

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive, with a steep learning curve that will keep you engaged for hours. As you progress through the game, the clock speed increases, making it even more challenging to catch the orbs. To succeed, you must develop a sense of timing and spatial awareness, allowing you to anticipate the orb's trajectory and position yourself for the perfect catch. With practice, you'll become more adept at handling the clock's movements and adapting to new situations, unlocking new levels and increasing your score.

One of the key features of Clock Head is its emphasis on timing and reaction speed. The game requires you to think on your feet and make split-second decisions, which can be both exhilarating and frustrating at the same time. However, with each failure, you'll learn from your mistakes and develop new strategies to overcome the challenges ahead.
